name: What unique factors should I consider when selling a waterfront home compared to a standard property?

mainEntity.name: What unique factors should I consider when selling a waterfront home compared to a standard property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selling a waterfront home involves specific considerations beyond a standard property sale. Factors like seawall condition, dock permits, flood zone designations, and potential erosion can significantly impact value and buyer interest. You should also prepare documentation for any riparian rights or submerged land leases. Understanding these nuances helps in setting the right price and targeting the appropriate buyers who value these unique aspects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterfront homes require attention to factors like seawall condition, dock permits, flood zones, and riparian rights, which differ from standard property sales.
